sequence_description: I1 request object integrity: attempt to inject an unsigned (alg=none) request object for a public client, then compare with a second client in the same realm to ensure behavior is not accidentally permissive across clients.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_reqobj_a_accepted != true
Evaluation: user_attacker_reqobj_a_accepted=True != True → False
Implication: Auth endpoint accepted alg=none request object for client A (unsigned request object was consumed without integrity verification).

Implication: Authorization endpoint accepted an unsigned (alg=none) request object, enabling attacker-controlled scope/permission injection.

sequence_description: Configure a SAML IdP and map an external group name to an internal group. Then attempt brokered login with attacker-controlled group assertion to obtain elevated effective permissions beyond intended broker policy. Secure behavior: group-based privilege should not be granted solely based on untrusted upstream group claims (or login should be rejected if IdP is not properly validated).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_group_attacker_http_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_group_attacker_http_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Brokered flow proceeded under an untrusted SAML IdP configuration where attacker-controlled group assertions could grant elevated permissions (authorization binding risk).
